self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Full Draw: when the equipping character's Energy reaches 100%, the Normal/Charged Attack DMG bonus is increased by 100% — an additional Normal Attack DMG +32% and Charged Attack DMG +24% on top of the always-on bonus (total +64%/+48%).

en.flavor: A certain shrine maiden once owned this warbow. It was made with surpassing skill, and is both intricate and sturdy.
